facts.fact: Wingu's release of 2 June 2025 says its two Djibouti facilities give access to 12 operational submarine cables, the second site hosting the country's first integrated cable landing station and data centre; stations not otherwise named.

Wingu describes itself as carrier-neutral and says its Djibouti cable landing station and data centre serve customers including telecom and content providers and hyperscalers, who obtain cable access there.
